answer_1.quote: We present a grounded pragmatic dialogue system which collaborates successfully with people on the task above.
answer_1.outputs: dialogue utterances and dot selections in a collaborative reference game

answer_2.quote: We compare our full system (FULL) to ablated versions of it... using the automatic evaluations of past work.

answer_4.quote: We perform, for the first time, human evaluations on the full dialogue task, finding that our system cooperates with people substantially more successfully than a system from past work...
answer_4.guideline: Workers were paired with a system or another worker, and success was measured by whether both players selected the same dot. Workers were filtered by qualifications, shown a tutorial, and prevented from selecting dots within the first minute. They were paid $0.30 per game with a $0.15 bonus for success.
